name: retention time
definition: A time interval from the start of chromatography when an analyte exits a chromatographic column (PSI-MS MS:1000894).

name: m/z
definition: The quantity m/z: the mass of an ion in daltons divided by its charge number, a dimensionless value used as the abscissa of a mass spectrum (PSI-MS MS:1000040; not the physical ratio of mass to electric charge).

name: spectral library compound name
definition: Name of the compound whose reference spectrum in a spectral library matched an observed spectrum, as given by the library.

name: spectral library match ID
definition: Identifier of the reference spectrum in a spectral library that matched an observed spectrum, for example a GNPS spectrum ID.

name: spectral match score
definition: Similarity score between an observed spectrum and a matched library spectrum, for example the GNPS MQScore (modified cosine).

name: adduct
definition: Ion species formed from a molecule in mass spectrometry, for example M+H or M-H, written as given by the source.

name: MS1 feature area
definition: Area of an LC-MS MS1 feature: the ion intensity of the feature's m/z integrated over its chromatographic peak, in instrument arbitrary units (PSI-MS MS:1001844).
